text:
emma: Quick heads-up — kicking off final marketplace onboarding checklist for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need decisions on: trial SKU vs metered trial, AMI naming convention, and KMS key rotation timing. Can we align by EOD Thu? :calendar:

raj: I'm leaning metered trial for GA — less maintenance for entitlements. Can we have a short doc showing differences in billing flows? :money_with_wings:

lia: Legal prefers trial SKU for clarity in T&Cs, but we can do metered as long as EULA language covers consumption-based trials. I can draft the clause but need final SKU naming.

emma: Cool. For AMI naming, david suggested a pattern, posting here: `redwood-inference-ami-{cloud}-{region}-{version}`. Thoughts?

david: That pattern works. A small ask: include build id for fast rollback, e.g. `redwood-inference-ami-{cloud}-{region}-v{semver}-b{build}`. Keeps it unique.

oliver: From partner ops POV, ensure AMI tags include `partner_integrations` and `marketplace_approved:true`. Downstream tooling filters on tags.

lia: Also need export-control checkboxes in onboarding package. Some of our models have restricted components — add a line in the listing assets checklist.

emma: Noted. Marketplace-bot: can you run a preflight validation on the draft listing with the new AMI pattern and KMS rotations?

marketplace-bot: Validation job queued (job id `pv-2026-04-05-11`). Run complete: 3 warnings, 1 failure. Failure: missing EULA localization for de/fr. Warnings: missing tag `marketplace_approved`, KMS rotation window outside recommended 90-day window, trial-sku mapping not present for Azure.

emma: Ugh — localization miss. Lia, can you quick-turn German/French EULA snippets? We can drop in placeholders but risk rejection.

lia: I can put together minimal localized text for review by EOD tomorrow. Will coordinate with translations.

raj: On trial vs metered — if we do metered, engineering needs a fallback SKU for offline entitlement lookups. david, can the runtime emit a `trial_approx` header so billing can map consumption?

david: Yes, runtime can emit `x-rwd-trial-mode: metered` and a `x-rwd-trial-estimate` token count. Need a 2-day sprint to ship.

oliver: Ops note — for Azure private offers we need legacy tenant IDs. I'll collect the sample IDs today and post them to the onboarding doc.

emma: Great. Action items: lia = localized EULAs, david = runtime header + AMI naming update, oliver = tenant ID list, raj = billing flow doc (short). I'll run another marketplace-bot preflight Thurs morning. If that passes we'll submit for vendor listing. :thumbsup: 

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: preflight run at 2026-04-09T09:00Z (job id `pv-2026-04-09-09`).
